name: Asahina Chitose
source: Energetic and cheerful girl but becoming lazy and unmotivated when it comes to "Gleam" training. She used to be talented athlete before becoming Witch. Her "Gleam" is granting herself "Luck" by absorbing from the others.
translation: Energetic and cheerful girl but becoming lazy and unmotivated when it comes to "Gleam" training. She used to be talented athlete before becoming Witch. Her "Gleam" is granting herself "Luck" by absorbing from the others.
